verdict.rationale: Evidence is entirely first-party marketing copy about creative capability and 'smart power efficiency' claims, with no documented power envelopes (TDP/PL1/PL2), no sustained-performance benchmarking, and no independent third-party testing of thermal throttling or performance-per-watt during long renders/exports. missing for 10: documented power envelope specs, independent sustained-load/throttling benchmarks, render-export-specific perf-per-watt data.
